term.def: AI ROI means the real business value a company gets back from its AI spending, measured in time saved, cost cut, or revenue gained.

prompt.prompt: List 3 ways we could measure whether our AI tools for [team or process] are actually saving time or money, not just getting used.

quiz.q: Times Square Chronicles reports that only 13% of CIOs say AI has delivered significant value so far.
quiz.why: This restates the headline's own finding about CIOs and AI value.

quiz.q: The Times of India reports that FIIs pumped Rs 38,971 crore into Indian equities amid an AI sell-off.
quiz.why: This matches the figure and context given in the headline.

quiz.q: AI always gives accurate answers because it truly understands facts the way a person does.
quiz.why: AI predicts likely words based on patterns, so it can sound confident while being wrong.

quiz.q: AI tools can sometimes produce answers that sound fluent but are factually incorrect.
quiz.why: This is a well known limitation often called hallucination, and managers should always verify key facts.

quiz.q: Buying an AI tool automatically improves business results without any change to how teams work.
quiz.why: Value usually comes from redesigning workflows around the tool, not from the tool alone.
